Mental disability
Equal Treatment Bench Book – July 2024 (February 2026 update) 91
Bail and remand decisions

88. Research has shown that due to the difficulties courts face in obtaining full and accurate
information about defendants’ needs, there is significant overuse of custodial remand for the
purpose of facilitating psychiatric assessments.171

89. Prison can be wrongly viewed as a speedy and reliable place of safety for vulnerable
individuals. L&D Services should be able to help obtain timely information about defendants’
support needs, including referrals for support while defendants await subsequent court
appearances.
